_about: High school board. One entry per prospect. ll = [lon, lat] of the city he plays in now. r247 = 247Sports national rank (used by the Win model's freshman projection); rOn3 = On3 Industry rank; rEspn / rRivals as listed. Leave out anything unknown. tier = staff big-board color (green / yellow / red); none = not colored on the board. rInd = On3 Industry (consensus) national rank.
